title: Rabbi Tachna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Seder HaDorot cites that he is mentioned in Pirkei deRabbi Eliezer, chapter 55, but Hyman says Pirkei deRabbi Eliezer has only fifty-four chapters. He says the reference should be to chapters 46 and 53, as cited in the introduction of the Gaon Radal, who wrote there that it is a scribal error for Rabbi Tanchum, and so it is in several printings.

notes.text: The consulted text has Tachna in chapters 49 and 53. The chapter numbers and Radal’s correction to Tanchum are reported as Hyman gives them.
